visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor sports facility. A young girl, about three years old, sits on a wooden bench. An adult woman in a white hoodie and denim shorts sits beside her, carefully adjusting black and white elbow protectors on the girl's small arms. On the bench, an orange cup with a straw is visible. (2) The camera moves to a close-up framing the girl's face. A pair of hands enters the frame to place a white protective helmet on her head. The girl looks at the camera with a serious yet cooperative expression as the adult ensures the chin strap is securely and comfortably fastened for the upcoming activity. (3) The scene transitions to an indoor ski slope simulator featuring a large moving white belt. The girl is now standing on a snowboard, wearing full safety gear including knee pads and gloves. A female instructor dressed in black shorts and a black t-shirt holds the girl's hands, guiding her balance. (4) The girl practices snowboarding as the white belt moves beneath her. The background mural depicts a majestic snow-covered mountain range under a blue sky. The girl maintains a low stance, looking focused. She briefly loses her balance and sits down on the belt, but the instructor quickly helps her back up. (5) A male instructor in a black t-shirt and white helmet takes over, holding the girl's hand as she slides more confidently. The girl looks towards the camera and waves with one hand, showing her enjoyment. The camera pans slightly to follow her movement across the simulated snowy surface of the facility. (6) The child transitions from snowboarding to sitting on a blue plastic sled. She slides down the slope with a joyful expression. At the bottom, she is met by her mother. The two share an enthusiastic high-five, and the girl laughs, clearly proud of her successful day of learning and play. (7) The final phase is a simple animated sequence on a plain yellow background. It features stylized cartoon illustrations of a parent and a child. Below the characters, the text "CUI'S FAMILY LIFE" is displayed in a clean, sans-serif font, serving as the channel's concluding brand identity and logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the energetic voice of an adult female narrator speaking Mandarin with a high-pitched, friendly tone and high pitch variability. In the background, a mid-tempo electronic pop music track begins, characterized by bright synthesizer pads and a rhythmic drum pattern at approximately 128 BPM. (2) Acoustic details include the soft rustling of clothing and the subtle mechanical clicking of safety gear being adjusted. The room tone suggests a large indoor space with a slight reverb. The female voice remains dominant, maintaining a high arousal level and positive valence to encourage the young child listener. (3) A prominent, continuous broadband hissing sound enters the mix, representing the friction of the snowboard against the moving simulator belt. This mechanical noise creates a dense texture but does not mask the voices. Occasional soft thuds and the scraping of the board's edges provide a realistic soundscape. (4) A male voice is introduced, speaking with a professional, calm, yet encouraging tone. The speech rate is moderate. A distinct low-frequency thud is heard when the child falls, followed by an immediate swell in the adult's vocal volume to offer comfort and praise. The BGM continues its steady rhythmic pulse. (5) The sound of the moving belt persists as a steady ambient layer. Rhythmic swooshing sounds of the snowboard are heard in sync with the child's movements. The interaction between the voices of the male instructor and the child creates a multi-layered vocal environment, full of positive energy and excitement. (6) The friction sound changes in quality, becoming smoother as the child slides down on a plastic sled. High-pitched laughter from the child is heard, peaking in amplitude and spectral brightness. A crisp, high-frequency "clap" sound marks a high-five, followed by loud, joyful exclamations from the adults present. (7) The active environmental sounds cut out, replaced by a clean, studio-recorded audio tail. The BGM concludes with a short melodic flourish. The final second is characterized by studio silence, providing a clear ending to the narrative sequence. There are no distortions or technical artifacts in the mastered track.
